name: grasp_greedy
prompt:
Output exactly five Python lines that grasp and lift a brick. Use only these two calls:
await robot.grip("left", width)
await robot.move("left", x, y, z, speed)
All values must be numeric literals. The robot uses inverse kinematics. Units are metres. For a brick at x=0.20, y=-0.18 with bottom z=0.0000, here is a complete example:
await robot.grip("left", 0.026)
await robot.move("left", 0.20, -0.18, 0.1071, 0.04)
await robot.move("left", 0.20, -0.18, 0.0071, 0.015)
await robot.grip("left", 0.0)
await robot.move("left", 0.20, -0.18, 0.1071, 0.04)

Now grasp a DIFFERENT brick at x=0.240, y=-0.140, bottom z=-0.000. It has the same height. Output only the five Python lines for the new brick.
response:
await robot.grip("left", 0.026)
await robot.move("left", 0.240, -0.140, 0.1071, 0.04)
await robot.move("left", 0.240, -0.140, 0.0071, 0.015)
await robot.grip("left", 0.0)
await robot.move("left", 0.240, -0.140, 0.1071, 0.04)
